# Rules Schema: AI Agent Culture Validator

---

## 1. Rule Format

```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "manifesto_name": "AI Engineering Culture & Standards Manifesto",
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "CULT01",
      "name": "Zero Lazy Code & Complete Implementation",
      "severity": "P0_BLOCKING",
      "penalty_points": 35,
      "description": "Prohibits incomplete code generated by AI agents.",
      "rationale": "AI agents must not deliver tasks with hidden operational gaps.",
      "remediation": "Implement the logic completely."
    }
  ]
}
```
